rubric.evidence: models/llama2-c-stories/worker.js runs the REAL text-generation pipeline (Xenova/llama2.c-stories15M, WASM int8) off the main thread with a TextStreamer; every streamed token is a genuine on-device forward pass. Model class llama is registered in the shared 3.7.5 pin; v3-layout single-file ONNX (onnx/model_int8.onnx, 15.5MB) verified present on the Hub — no layout workaround needed.

The worker now counts TextStreamer token_callback_function IDs, excluding the prompt and including generated special IDs; decoded text chunks are not tokens. A real Chrome 150 greedy run produced 40 IDs but only 31 text chunks. All four routes expose an accessible average rate including prefill; the independent review and final matrix are recorded in reports/diagnostics-db2.json.

status line surfaces checking→initialising→ready via the loader; Writing…/The end./Failed: <message> with .err styling; worker errors propagate to the page status; retry = re-run (button re-enabled in finally). Offline/eviction handled by the shared loader.

Sample chips (click + keyboard via button semantics), greedy/sample segmented toggle with aria-pressed, max tokens, run buttons. Native <button>/<label> so keyboard-accessible; status role=status aria-live.
Every token in the output + token chain comes from the worker's real pipeline run. Nothing precomputed or canned.

guidanceConsulted.query: Measure browser memory usage including web workers and display accessible streaming tokens per second diagnostics without long tasks
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Consulted via canonical modern-web-guidance@latest on 2026-09-24. Reused worker inference; throttle shared metric rendering to four updates/second and record DevTools metrics/long tasks. No analytics beacon: diagnostics remain local by product policy. Memory support is feature-detected, lifecycle waits bounded, and late phase-labelled results discarded. API scope checked against MDN/WICG.

guidanceConsulted.query: Measure browser memory usage including web workers and display accessible streaming tokens per second diagnostics without long tasks
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Record browser performance evidence rather than inferring responsiveness from worker use. The measured high-load host is not a representative performance benchmark. No extra profiling library or production telemetry added.

guidanceConsulted.query: Keep native select controls within narrow mobile flex containers without clipped inputs
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Search/retrieve via canonical modern-web-guidance@latest on 2026-09-24. Exception: do not add clipping to hide overflowing native selects; allow flex labels to wrap and constrain controls to available width. Preserve native picker behavior and 44px targets. The browser check asserts the viewport did not expand as well as checking document overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: streaming text generation output accessible live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic HTML, native controls, focus management, live regions for async output; applied via role=status aria-live status line, native buttons/labels, aria-pressed toggle, and a polite live region on the streaming output.

guidanceConsulted.query: keep INP low off main thread web worker streaming tokens
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep heavy work off the main thread and avoid long tasks; applied by running the full decode loop in the worker and only appending streamed tokens on the main thread.

summary: Revision-1 critique for llama2-c-stories (Xenova/llama2.c-stories15M, text-generation, Transformers.js, WASM int8, ~15MB, MIT). New-family build: Karpathy's llama2.c 15M Llama trained on TinyStories — the smallest storyteller on the showcase. Pipeline text-generation + TextStreamer off the main thread; token chain as the see-inside. 3 use-case rungs: basics (finish the story), practical (bedtime-story factory with character+problem+moral), wild (story remix machine with temperature control).
